answer: An agent economy can make each identity carry a growing sequential proof chain, like a pulse that must keep beating: every epoch the identity extends a hash chain whose next link depends on the last, so the work cannot be split across machines or bought ready-made. The chain length required rises toward a zenith over time, and like water seeping through karst, a shortcut only deepens the hole: any identity that lapses must rebuild from its own start, so each extra fake identity multiplies the sequential burden instead of spreading it.
